name: capell-app/widget-content-reveal
description: Short cards with buttons that open another part of the same page in a pop-up or a panel that slides in from the side.

marketplace.summary: Teaser cards that open your prices, team details or other parts of the same page on the spot, in a pop-up or side panel.
marketplace.description: Add up to twelve short cards to a page, each with a title, a line of teaser text and a button. The button opens another part of the same page, picked from a searchable list, in a pop-up or a panel sliding in from the side. Visitors close it and carry on from where they were. Cards keep pointing at the right part when you rearrange the page. A card can't reach a different page, and if the part it opens is removed, the card opens nothing. It needs Layout Builder to place it on a page.
marketplace.problem: Long pages make visitors give up before they reach prices, team details or the menu.
marketplace.outcome: Visitors scan short cards, open only the detail they want and carry on from the same place.

faq.question: What can a card open?
faq.answer: Something you have already built on the same page, such as a price list or a team section. A card cannot open content from a different page.

faq.question: How does the content appear?
faq.answer: In a pop-up over the page or in a side panel, chosen card by card. Visitors close it and carry on from the same spot.

faq.question: How many cards can one block hold?
faq.answer: Up to twelve, each with a title, a line of teaser text and a button label.

faq.question: Do the cards break if I rearrange the page?
faq.answer: No. Each card is tied to the content it opens and not to where that content sits, so it keeps opening the right part after you move things around.
